mentions.name: Limzo
mentions.description: This bot provides free anti-spam and moderation for Telegram groups. About 750 groups tried it within 11 weeks and 353 still have it installed.
mentions.problem: About half of all removals happen in the first hour, mostly in tiny groups of friends, and it is not yet understood what those groups expected from the bot.
